en.t: Tamakazura also rode out in a carriage to watch the spectacle.

units.source_text: 她看到了竞赛新装的许多达官贵人的容貌风采，

en.t: She saw the faces and bearing of many high-ranking nobles and dignitaries competing in their new finery,

units.source_text: 又从旁窥看冷泉帝穿着红袍正襟危坐的端丽姿态，觉得毕竟无人比得上他。

en.t: and from the side she glimpsed Emperor Reizei sitting upright and graceful in his red robe, and felt that no one could compare with him after all.

units.source_text: 她偷偷地注目观看自己的父亲内大臣，果然服饰辉煌，相貌堂堂，而又春秋鼎盛。

en.t: She secretly fixed her eyes on her own father, the Minister of the Center; his clothing was indeed splendid, his appearance imposing, and he was in the prime of life.
Yet in the end he seemed ordinary.

units.source_text: 他在臣下之中，固然比别人优越，但看了凤辇中的龙颜之后，别的人都不足观了。

en.t: Among the courtiers he was certainly superior to others, but after seeing the imperial face within the phoenix carriage, everyone else seemed scarcely worth looking at.

units.source_text: 至于青年侍女们所赞颂为“美貌”“俊俏”而死命地恋慕的柏木中将、弁少将、某某殿上人之类的男子，

en.t: As for men such as Kashiwagi, the lieutenant general, Ben no Shosho, and various courtiers whom the young waiting women praised as beautiful and handsome and loved with desperate devotion,

units.source_text: 更是毫无可取，不入玉鬘眼中，只因冷泉帝的相貌确是优美无比的。

en.t: they had even less to recommend them and did not catch Tamakazura's eye at all, simply because Emperor Reizei's looks were truly beyond compare.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣的相貌酷肖龙颜，竟无半点差异。

en.t: The face of Genji, the Grand Minister, closely resembled the imperial countenance, with not the slightest difference.

units.source_text: 不过恐是心情所使然，似觉冷泉帝更有威严，光采咄咄逼人。

en.t: Yet perhaps because of her feelings, Emperor Reizei seemed to her more majestic, with a brilliance that pressed powerfully upon the viewer.

units.source_text: 如此看来，这种美男子都是世间难得看到的。

en.t: Seen in this way, such handsome men were rarely to be found in the world.

units.source_text: 玉鬘看惯了源氏及夕雾中将等的美貌，以为凡是贵人，相貌都很漂亮，都与常人相异。

en.t: Tamakazura was used to the beauty of Genji, Lieutenant General Yugiri, and others, and had thought that all nobles were beautiful and unlike ordinary people.

units.source_text: 今日始知别的贵人虽然身穿盛装，但相形之下姿色全消，令人几疑为丑汉，但觉他们眼睛鼻子都生得异样，个个都被残酷地压倒了。

en.t: Only today did she realize that other nobles, though dressed in splendid clothes, lost all their charm by comparison, almost making one suspect them of being ugly men; their eyes and noses seemed oddly formed, and each of them had been harshly overshadowed.
